resources.string: Tasks can make you unexpectedly fall asleep.
After completing a task, you may fall asleep after a random delay. While asleep, you are blind, unable to move, and unable to interact.
Completing a task can make you unexpectedly drowsy. After a short, unpredictable delay, you fall asleep: your screen goes dark and you cannot move or interact until you wake up.
Sometimes an action slips at the worst moment, briefly delaying what you were trying to do.
Sometimes an action slips at the worst moment. When you fumble, the action is briefly delayed before it can go through, which can throw off your timing when you need it most.
Your movement occasionally stutters, briefly freezing you before you carry on.
Your movement occasionally stutters. Starting to move or making a sharp change of direction can briefly freeze you before movement resumes, making your character feel like it suddenly lagged.
Convince another player to kill you and secure your personal win.

Convince another player to kill you and secure your personal win. Being guessed, executed in a meeting, ejected, disconnected, or causing your own death does not count. A successful qualifying out-of-meeting kill from another player completes your objective.

Convince another player to kill you and secure your personal win. Being guessed, executed in a meeting, ejected, disconnected, or causing your own death does not count. A successful qualifying out-of-meeting kill from another player completes your objective.
Spread a hidden fungal infection through the crew.
Infect players at close range. Infected players silently spread the fungus through successful interactions.

Infect nearby players and let the fungus spread through successful player-to-player interactions. New infections begin hidden and become more visible after meetings. Fungi can recognize infected players and each other. Spread the infection far enough to complete your objective.

Infect nearby players and let the fungus spread through successful interactions. New infections begin hidden and become more visible after meetings. Multiple Fungi work toward the same infection objective.
Dust a player with invisible trace powder. Anyone who directly interacts with them leaves evidence only you can see.

Dust a player with invisible trace powder. Anyone who directly interacts with your Dusted target leaves private evidence only you can see. Trace does not spread beyond that first contact. Use the evidence to work out who has been near your target and why.

Dust a player with invisible trace powder. Direct contact with your Dusted target leaves private Trace evidence only you can see. Trace can reveal a killer who murders your target and remains until after the next meeting.
Secretly place players on Death Row. Their sentence is revealed at the next meeting and carried out when voting ends.

Use Death Note on a nearby non-Impostor to secretly place them on Death Row. You privately see a Death Note marker beside everyone you have condemned. At the next meeting, living condemned players are publicly marked with a red skull. Valid sentences are carried out when voting ends. Using Death Note resets your normal Kill cooldown.

Use Death Note to secretly place a non-Impostor on Death Row. The Condemner privately sees a Death Note tracker on every marked player. Living condemned players are revealed with a public red skull at the next meeting and remain able to vote, guess, and use meeting abilities until their sentence is resolved.
Protect the crew from lethal attacks.
Protect multiple players from lethal attacks. The first attacker to trigger a protection is marked red for you to hunt.

Protect living players from lethal attacks. Protections last while you are alive. The first attacker to trigger protection is marked RED and unlocks your Kill button. Only that marked attacker can be killed. Meeting guesses and ejections bypass protection.

Protect multiple living players from lethal attacks. A protected player knows they are protected. The first attacker to trigger a protection is marked red only for you and becomes your hunt target. While the hunt is active, your Kill button can only target that marked attacker.
Finish your tasks. Become the wall.
Complete all of your tasks to gain permanent protection from ordinary direct kill attempts.

Complete all assigned tasks to activate Tank protection. Once active, ordinary direct kill attempts against you are blocked. Indirect attacks, defense-bypassing attacks, meeting kills and ejections still work normally.
Complete every assigned task to activate permanent protection from ordinary direct kill attempts. If Can See Who Tried To Kill is enabled, a blocked attack also tells the Tank who attacked them.
The dead reveal which side they belonged to.
Incoming kills may fail to kill you.
Your vote secretly carries no voting power.
